card.name: "Other" or "wrong" before product comparisons
card.fires_on: The words "other" or "wrong" right before a drug or product noun, mostly after "As with" or "selecting the". It sits where a comparison to other products comes next.

modes.label: As with other
modes.description: "other" after "As with" or "with many" introducing a class-effect statement about similar drugs.
modes.example: Hematologic Toxicity As with<< other>> cytotoxic agents, doxorubicin

modes.label: Wrong product
modes.description: "wrong" in storage text about avoiding selection of the wrong product.
modes.example: in a manner that minimizes the possibility of selecting the<< wrong>> product [see Warnings and Preca

modes.label: Other products
modes.description: "other" before a product noun when saying not to mix with other products.
modes.example: Do not use actuators from<< other>> products with the DULERA canister

card.writes: It promotes compare-type words, suggesting the model expects a comparison with other products.
card.plain: It flags the word "other" or "wrong" where the label sets this drug against other products.
